switch_routing.description: Charged only when a swap could not settle DIRECT and had to route through the national switch. Not charged on DIRECT-mode swaps.
switch_routing.amount_note: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the actual per-transaction tariff from your switch operator agreement. Change amount_type to 'percentage' + 'rate' if the switch charges a % of Amount_1 instead of a flat fee.
switch_routing.deduction_note: F23 is NOT split 50/50 flat. It is allocated between source and destination in proportion to their normal revenue_split percentages for this swap type (e.g. DEPOSIT: source=15%, destination=50% of the pool → source absorbs 15/65 of F23, destination absorbs 50/65 of F23). Platform's share is never reduced by F23.
switch_routing.settlement_description: F23 is computed and recorded on every switch-routed transaction at swap time (so each institution's true net share is visible immediately in fee_calculation_details), but no separate cash movement happens per swap. VouchMorph accrues the F23 liability per institution, then nets and settles/invoices the switch operator in a single batch at each calendar month end — consistent with standard EFT/RTC-style clearing (gross recording, netted deferred settlement) rather than per-transaction gross settlement.

F7.name: Swap Levy
F7.description: VouchMorph's own internal swap levy. NOT a government-mandated fee -- despite the name 'levy', this is retained by VouchMorph, not remitted to any regulator. F10.name: Retry Fee

F23.name: National Switch Fee
F23.description: Fee charged by the national switch when a swap could not settle DIRECT. See switch_routing section above for allocation rules.
